notes: hand-built (the terraced dome read as a stepped pyramid, and its peak sat mid-face where a cup is open). Hood = a shell sliced along X: each slice is an extruded quarter-superellipse band from the top edge at the door out to the lower lip at the projection, hollow underneath for the fingers; +Z = down the door, screws on z = 0. Boxy hood (superellipse front and section) under a flat top rail, round screw ears at the ends (M1684_0/_1)
